markers.reading: The party sleeps after the werewolf fighting and wakes at the inn in pre-dawn darkness with long-rest benefits.

evidence.quote: So, as you drift to sleep in the comfortable beds at the inn recovering from a long day of fighting werewolves, the full moon climbs higher in the night sky.
And you awake in the pre-dawn darkness, how would you like to start your day? Kong, I just sent you a quick message and remember: long rest.
as you get there it's—it's still dark, but the moon is bright

markers.note: The overnight itself crosses a date boundary; whether its sleeping start belongs to this session or the previous session remains open.

markers.reading: Leave the tunnels at sunrise and travel north toward the fort for about two hours, reaching a scouting position roughly half a mile south of the summit.

evidence.quote: You travel through these tunnels and emerge, just as the sun is beginning to rise over the horizon.
So you begin to travel and you can see, after couple miles, maybe three miles, maybe close to an hour's journey as the sun starts to get a bit higher in the sky.
Continue for another two, three miles, another hour, maybe the sun rises higher in the sky until you're maybe a little less than a mile maybe half a mile south of the summit of this hill

offset.basis: two narrated legs of about an hour each

end.basis: elapsed journey; no numerical sunrise clock

duration.basis: two successive narrated legs of roughly an hour

markers.reading: Seeker watches the tower occupants through Clairvoyance for a few minutes.

evidence.quote: This goes on for a few minutes, the muttering sometimes—while you can't hear anything, you can just see his mouth moving.

markers.reading: The party takes a short rest while interrogating the prisoners; later hit-die recovery confirms the rest credit.

evidence.quote: I mean, can we take a short rest while we're doing this, too?
Take a short rest and interrogate them
We should take a short rest and spend hit dice and get up there.
No, that was fine I between hit dice and my.

markers.note: The closing short-rest/hit-die discussion does not unambiguously establish a second separate rest; credit is counted once.

yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No current calendar date is spoken. July 3, 1748 comes from YAML; the overnight leads into the pre-dawn adventure. August 1 is a future ritual date, and the prisoner’s years/months concern background.
yamlCheck.explanation: The waking-to-closing adventure is compatible with one day. Including the opening sleep extends the covered start to the preceding night; its session boundary remains unresolved. No additional overnight is completed in closing play.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: Opening narration explicitly traverses sleep and waking, but may bridge the previous session’s closing rest rather than add a new starting day.

alternatives.reading: Treat sleep as the previous session’s handoff and start the covered adventure with waking on the YAML date.
Include the opening sleeping scene; conditional on the YAML waking date, begin on the preceding evening.
